messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: ggplot2 sneak peek
parts:
Hi all,

I'm going to be giving a webinar to Orange County R Users Group on Dec
1 6-7pm PST. It'll be a brief review of why I think you should learn
ggplot2, and then a look at what new features are coming in the next
release.

For more info, and to sign up, please visit http://linkd.in/vcn8dw.

Hadley

--
Assistant Professor / Dobelman Family Junior Chair
Department of Statistics / Rice University
http://had.co.nz/
